From: Alyssa Grant <alyssa@novumai.com>

Date: Mon, 04 Oct 2027 09:23:00 -0700
Subject: Dedicated capacity walkthrough — NovumAI

Hi Marissa,

I signed up through the self-serve flow and requested a dedicated capacity walkthrough. We're evaluating Reserved/Dedicated options for a private deployment and wanted to get a sense of whether Redwood can meet our throughput and latency targets before we move to a procurement discussion.

Quick context: NovumAI runs a customer-facing assistant that averages ~2M tokens/day across pax of concurrent users during peak (rough ballpark). Key constraints: p95 generation latency target <200ms for 512-token responses, and we want predictable unit economics (we're sensitive to batching/quantization tradeoffs).

Can we set up a 30–45 minute technical walkthrough that covers: model variant tradeoffs for latency, autoscaling/burst behavior for peak events, and what metrics you need from our side to size Dedicated pools?

I've attached the signup export and a very short ops contact list — happy to loop in our infra lead if needed. Our timezone is PDT.

Thanks,
Alyssa Grant
Head of Product
NovumAI
alyssa@novumai.com

Thanks Ben / Marissa — Wed, Oct 6 at 09:30 PT works for us (please send calendar invite). 45 minutes is fine if your team wants the extra time to walk through tradeoffs.

I attached a short QPS / p95 estimate doc from our infra team — quick notes: typical peak ~85 RPS, p95 tokens/request ~420, and we expect burst windows that could raise RPS to ~220 for 3–6 minutes during high-traffic campaigns. Our goal is to keep p95 generation latency under 200ms for the 512-token SLA; we are open to recommendations on model quantization and KV cache strategies.
